items.title: George Shearing interviewed by Joe Williams, New York City, New York, March 8, 1996
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] That was before Charlie had it.

ctx.x: One was out there. One was in front of the bar. “One” [scats].
That was before Charlie had it.

Oh my gosh. But it still works out, the simple things I think are really more moving and they do it better than anything. There’s a guy that says, “Keep it simple, stupid.” There’s nobody needs to know how clever, you don’t have to show anybody how clever you are. I mean when you’re playing two people I think if you keep it simple, you’re going to be a big, big success. That’s the way I look at that. Now your wife is over there buttering something— oh my God. Well I think we’d better cut right here for a moment,…
